title: Mike Vrabel addresses family at Patriots OTAs after Russini controversy: 'I love Jen'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel addresses family at Patriots OTAs after Russini controversy: 'I love Jen'
sources.description: Mike Vrabel mostly kept it business as usual at a Patriots press conference Wednesday, May 27. But he praised his wife when asked about balancing family and football.
